_readme: All inputs for finance/calculator.py. Every value marked status=UNVERIFIED is an estimate and MUST be replaced with a quoted figure before launch. Currency: USD unless stated.

fx.status: UNVERIFIED - placeholder rate. Replace with the rate on the day you model; PayPal applies its own rate plus spread.

fees.status: VERIFIED 2026-11-18 from paypal.com/in fee page and shopify.com/in/pricing (Basic plan). GST-on-fees is standard Indian GST on services; confirm with CA whether it is recoverable.

fixed_monthly.status: Shopify prices VERIFIED 2026-11-18 (shopify.com/in/pricing). Promo = INR 20/month for first 3 months. Domain approx USD 17/yr for a .com quoted by Shopify domain tool 2026-11-18 (renewal may differ). Excludes 18% GST on Shopify invoice.

products.name: Lick mat 2-pack + spatula bundle (US warehouse)
products.status: UNVERIFIED supplier + shipping. Single lick mats appear at USD 3.65-6.29 on wholesale sites (eroswholesale.com, uchangepromo.com, checked 2026-11-18). US-warehouse stock price assumed to already include import duty paid by the warehouse operator - CONFIRM with CJ.

products.name: Travel tech organizer pouch (China direct to AU)
products.status: UNVERIFIED. Competitor anchors: BAGSMART ~USD 15-17, Bellroy USD 59, Peak Design ~USD 60 (review sites, 2026-11-18). AU: no GST collection obligation below AUD 75k turnover (ATO) - confirm.

products.name: Magnetic gym phone mount (US warehouse)
products.status: UNVERIFIED. Competitor anchors: SmallRig USD 15-19, BLAUBECK USD 24.95, Arkon USD 39.95, A2C USD 41.78 (retailer listings 2026-11-18). Higher refund allowance for magnet-strength and phone-compatibility complaints.

cashflow.supplier_payment: Upfront per order (CJ/AliExpress charge before fulfilment)
cashflow.status: Payout delay UNVERIFIED. New PayPal accounts may face holds/reserves; model a 21-day hold in the conservative case.
